segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on as 'Radio Cut Man' to open the Halloween broadcast.
segments.title: Station Sign-On

segments.notes: Case interviews Mayor Godzilla about city plans, Papito's Halloween costume, and the whereabouts of Godzuki.
segments.title: Mayor Godzilla Press Conference

segments.notes: Emergency election coverage with candidates Godzilla, Jeb's Dad, Gina Darling, Munch, Hamtaro hamster, and Papito; Gina Darling's huge head wins.
segments.title: Rennerton Mayoral Election Night

segments.notes: Gina Darling's severed forehead becomes mayor, declares war on loiterers, and is overrun by zombies after atomic poop discussion.
segments.title: Mayor Forehead Term

segments.notes: Hamster who loves Hamtaro (not Hamtaro) becomes mayor, focuses on wood farming and sleeping in wood chips before town is destroyed.
segments.title: Mayor Hamster Term

segments.notes: Munch declares 'Munchcut law,' builds army of 'banging redheaded archers,' faces protests from Crum, and survives until special election.
segments.title: Mayor Munch Martial Law Term

segments.notes: Crum wins emergency election 69-0, constructs walls and ballistas, claims 50% life regeneration, and stabilizes city before sign-off.
segments.title: Mayor Crum Landslide Term

segments.notes: Case closes broadcast, wishes happy Halloween, and raids Spinache.
segments.title: Sign-Off

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors Halloween special mayoral election coverage from the BIN newsroom while playing a city-builder simulation as Rennerton's successive mayors.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Delivers the station sign-on as 'Radio Cut Man' and appears as an in-game character surviving the loiterer hordes.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: Seizes mayoral power under martial law, builds an army of 'banging redheaded archers,' and loses a landslide election to Crum 69-0.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: Wins emergency mayoral election in a 69-0 landslide, constructs defensive walls, and claims 50% life regeneration while defending Rennerton.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito opens broadcast with station ID 'Radio Cut Man'.
Rennerton's citizens are 'extreme loiterers' — zombie-like hordes infesting the city.
Munch declares 'Munchcut law' (martial law) and claims grandfathered title of 'permanent catastrophe general'.
Crum wins emergency mayoral election in a 69-0 landslide over Munch.
Crum claims 'life regeneration plus 50%' as a mayoral upgrade.
Crum has athlete's foot on his head.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News presents a Halloween special election night in the ruined city of Rennerton, where successive mayors — Godzilla, Gina Darling's sentient forehead, a Hamtaro-loving hamster, Munch under martial law, and finally Crum in a 69-0 landslide — attempt to rebuild defenses against flesh-eating 'extreme loiterers.' Crum's term sees the construction of perimeter walls, an archer corps, and a claim of 50% life regeneration before the broadcast signs off.
